requirements.other_qualifications: Pass SPM/O-Level with minimum 5 credits (Grade C) including Mathematics; or UEC with minimum 3 subjects Grade B6; or STPM with minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.00); or Certificate Level 3 (MQF) with minimum CGPA 2.00; international applicants require a High School Certificate with minimum 50% and Grade C in Mathematics and English.
